# Resources

## General resources{.unnumbered}

**Official documentation**<br>
The [official documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs){target="_blank"} on Git is extensive and a great resource for learning about Git, and how to use specific commands. The official documentation also includes the freely available book [Pro Git]( https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2){target="_blank"}, which is well worth a read.

**Git exercises**<br>
<https://gitexercises.fracz.com/>{target="_blank"}

**boot.dev**<br>
[boot.dev](https://www.boot.dev/) has two great courses on Git.
